scope: Bounded nested GNOME Wayland compositor and portal capture attempt using the current Wayland backend

commands.command: Xvfb :99; XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=GNOME dbus-run-session -- gnome-shell --nested --wayland --no-x11 --wayland-display=wayland-99
commands.assertions: GNOME Shell 46.2 created the wayland-99 compositor socket and started its AT-SPI registry.
The GNOME portal implementation activated and returned a Request object, but no Response/capture completed within the bounded run; no image or input effect was accepted as evidence.

limitations: The nested compositor has no usable portal-approved capture stream in this environment; the permission request remained pending.
This is a runtime probe only and does not prove NAT-06 or the GNOME support row.
